That confirms all 11 files using `formatAmount` were covered. Results:

**17 call sites** still pass the second argument (out of 18 raw matches — one is the `function formatAmount(value, legacyRounding)` definition in `src\lib\format.js`, not a call site).

Breakdown by file:
- `src\reports\quarterly.js` — 5 (most)
- `src\billing\invoice.js` — 3
- `src\admin\exports.js` — 3
- `src\reports\monthly.js` — 2
- `src\checkout\cart.js` — 2
- `src\checkout\receipt.js` — 1
- `src\billing\statement.js` — 1

`src\reports\ledger.js`, `src\admin\dashboard.js`, and `src\billing\refunds.js` use `formatAmount` but already call it with one argument only.

**`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most**, with 5 call sites still passing the legacy rounding flag.
